baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal نَذِيرًا and the lamed phrase لِّلْبَشَرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The warning noun supplies a danger announcement meant to awaken caution, while the prepositional phrase assigns humankind as its addressee; the fragment leaves the warning's bearer or antecedent unstated.

activation_trace.role: The fear-awakening danger notice supplies the phrase's core alert function.
The visibly skinned human being supplies the collective audience of the alert.

changed_reading.before: An isolated nominal fragment with an unspecified relation to what surrounds it.
changed_reading.after: An unspecified bearer, event, or sign is presented as a danger-alert directed to humankind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conjunction of نَذِيرًا with the surface-bearing sense available in بَشَرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The alert is aimed not only at an abstract species but at the human as visibly surfaced and therefore exposed: bodily visibility becomes the material site at which danger can be noticed.

activation_trace.role: The caution-awakening warning supplies an alert that must become perceptible.
The visible outer skin or surface makes embodied exposure, rather than humanity in the abstract, salient.

changed_reading.before: A warning addressed generically to the human species.
changed_reading.after: A warning addressed to humans precisely as exposed, visible, embodied beings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَذِيرًا as advance notice and the first-visible-sign branch of ب ش ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without replacing بَشَرِ's syntactic sense of humans, its branch inventory lets the phrase depict warning as an early visible indication: something appears before the full danger and gives humans time to respond.

activation_trace.role: Advance disclosure of feared danger supplies the temporal lead needed for caution.
First visible signs or forerunners supply the warning's anticipatory image while the noun still denotes humans.

changed_reading.before: A verbal or propositional warning delivered to humans.
changed_reading.after: A warning that functions as the first visible arrival of what it announces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening rise-and-warn imperatives turn the focus nominal from a free-floating description into the realized public function of an initiated commission: the surah begins by setting warning in motion and later names its human-wide role.

activation_trace.role: The focus noun names the fear-awakening alert whose enacted origin the context supplies.
Resolute rising into an undertaking supplies initiation and agency to the warning function.
The imperative to issue a fear-awakening warning links the focus noun to the opening commission.

structural_cues: 74:2 couples an inceptive imperative with a warning imperative, while 74:36 reuses the warning root in a nominal accusative phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening commission and the later warning noun; I infer that 74:36 retrospectively names the commission's realized scope. A live alternative is that نَذِيرًا predicates the immediately described fire or 'one of the great' rather than the commissioned messenger.

changed_reading.after: The human-wide realization of the opening command to rise and warn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated بَشَر changes relational position: it is first made the alleged source or possessor of the speech, then the destination of reminder and warning. The focus لِّلْبَشَرِ therefore performs a social and grammatical reversal, relocating humans from claimed authorship to accountable reception.

activation_trace.role: Humanity is the focus phrase's lamed recipient rather than its source.
The human-being branch supplies the alleged possessor and source in 'speech of a human.'
The same human collective becomes the lamed destination of reminder, anticipating the focus construction.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts 74:25 قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ with 74:31 ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ and 74:36 نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one noun in contrasting genitive and lamed relations; I infer a deliberate correction from supposed human origin to human reception. The materially live alternative is simple lexical repetition without polemical relational force.

changed_reading.before: A warning whose audience happens to be humankind.
changed_reading.after: A relational correction: humankind is not the warning's authorial source but its addressed and accountable recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier description of an effect that marks or changes the human surface activates ب ش ر's skin branch in the focus. Warning becomes embodied evidence: danger is not only announced to humans but made visible upon the very surface by which humans are lexically figured.

activation_trace.role: The danger notice supplies the communicative warning whose visibility is intensified.
Visible outer skin supplies the embodied surface on which the warning can become legible.
The repeated skin-bearing human locates the preceding effect at an exposed human surface.
Heat that leaves a color-changing trace supplies the material process by which danger becomes bodily visible.

structural_cues: 74:28 says the danger neither leaves nor spares, and 74:29 immediately joins لَوَّاحَةٌ to لِّلْبَشَرِ before the focus repeats that lamed phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-spare, heat-marking, surface, and repeated-human cues; I infer that the focus retains a corporeal echo from 74:29. The ordinary collective sense 'humankind' remains fully live and need not be displaced.

changed_reading.before: An abstract warning delivered to a universal audience.
changed_reading.after: A warning aimed at exposed human bodies, with the threatened reality already legible as a surface-marking effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unveiling dawn gives the baseline forerunner reading a concrete temporal image. As night withdraws and light exposes what was covered, the focus warning can function like first light: an appearing sign that precedes fuller disclosure and permits response.

activation_trace.role: Advance notice of danger supplies the warning's anticipatory time relation.
First visible signs supply the forerunner image without replacing the noun's human referent.
The shining disclosure of dawn or face gives the warning's first-visible-sign branch a concrete cosmic enactment.

structural_cues: 74:32-35 stages moon, withdrawing night, revealing dawn, and then 'one of the great' immediately before the focus phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible temporal sequence and a focus branch of first signs; I infer that the sequence enacts warning as anticipatory disclosure. A live alternative treats the celestial sequence only as oath material and takes the focus as a direct predicate of Saqar or the great event.

changed_reading.before: A warning understood chiefly as verbal information.
changed_reading.after: A dawn-like forerunner whose visibility is itself advance notice to humans.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah converts warning into a decision boundary. Volition branches toward forward movement or chosen delay, so the focus is not merely a broadcast of danger; it is an intervention that makes each human's temporal direction explicit.

activation_trace.role: The caution-awakening notice supplies information in time for a consequential response.
Will directed toward an object supplies the choosing agency activated by the warning.
Forward advance supplies one directional outcome of receiving the warning.
Deferral to a later time supplies the opposed response of remaining behind.

structural_cues: 74:37 immediately follows the human-directed warning with لِمَن شَاءَ and a balanced advance-or-delay pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, volition, and opposed motion; I infer that warning creates the fork rather than merely describing its audience. The live alternative is that 74:37 only distributes an already complete warning among recipient types.

changed_reading.before: A warning whose task ends when humans hear it.
changed_reading.after: A threshold disclosure that exposes whether a hearer moves forward or deliberately defers.

context_deltas.mechanism: A danger warning ordinarily makes its recipient withdraw from the danger. The later animal-flight sequence reverses that function: recipients turn their side and flee from the reminder itself, so the warning also becomes a diagnostic stimulus that reveals misdirected caution.

activation_trace.role: A notice designed to awaken fearful caution supplies the expected movement away from danger.
The reminder that causes recollection identifies the very warning-object from which the recipients recoil.
Turning one's side supplies the initial bodily reorientation away from the reminder.
Startled distancing supplies the collective recoil produced by the warning's reception.
Outright escape completes the inversion: flight is directed away from warning rather than from warned-of danger.

structural_cues: 74:49-51 moves from turning away from the reminder to startled animals fleeing a pursuer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a caution-awakening warning and a later flight away from reminder; I supply the reversal arrow that the proper object of flight is danger, not its notice. An alternative is that the animal image depicts aversion without commenting on warning's intended mechanics.

changed_reading.before: A warning that simply transmits feared information.
changed_reading.after: A warning that tests orientation: its rejection is exposed as flight from the alarm instead of flight from the danger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close names absence of fear as failed reception, recasts the discourse as a reminder to be retained, and ends with protection and shielding from sin's effect. This gives the warning a protective teleology: fear is awakened so damage may be avoided and its consequences covered.

activation_trace.role: The fear-awakening danger notice supplies the intervention whose end is now traced beyond fear itself.
A reminder that restores attention supplies the cognitive persistence by which warning can keep operating.
Anticipatory fear of harm names the response whose absence blocks the warning's caution mechanism.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the practical end toward which awakened caution can move.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies a reparative endpoint beyond avoidance alone.

structural_cues: 74:53-56 proceeds from not fearing the hereafter, through reminder and conditional remembrance, to God's worthiness of protective caution and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, reminder, self-protection, and consequence-shielding; I infer a causal arc from warning through attention to protection and repair. A live alternative is that the final divine attributes qualify remembrance without redefining the focus warning's purpose.

changed_reading.before: A threat-centered notice whose purpose is to frighten humans.
changed_reading.after: A protective intervention that awakens fear in time for shelter, remembered correction, and forgiveness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the form نَذِيرًا most directly activates the warning branch, not vow or wound-compensation senses. It remains anchored in two packet branches of the same focus root and is activated by the later earning-and-held-pledge sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a legal resonance of warning that makes liability salient, never as a replacement translation of نَذِيرًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The self-binding and obligatory-compensation branches of focus root ن ذ ر.

activation_trace.role: Voluntarily making a non-obligatory act binding supplies a latent shift from hearing warning to incurring commitment.
Compensation owed for a wound supplies the more distant image of danger becoming a legally cognizable claim.
Acquiring a gain supplies the accounting motion by which each choice becomes something accrued.
A document or pledge held against a right turns accrued action into enforceable personal liability.

changed_reading.before: The warning reports an external danger that exists independently of the hearer's response.
changed_reading.after: The warning also resembles notice of a claim: once choices are made under it, the human becomes bound by what was personally accrued.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because بَشَرِ in the focus denotes humans, whereas face-brightening tidings are only another branch of its root, and the phrase is overtly a warning. It remains anchored in the focus root inventory and gains functional support from the final protection and forgiveness cues. Downstream prose should call it an ironic or cross-branch resonance: severe warning can be beneficial news because it arrives before avoidable harm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The collision of warning root ن ذ ر with the tidings branch of focus root ب ش ر.

activation_trace.role: A feared-danger announcement supplies the severity that makes the good-tidings resonance paradoxical.
News that opens and brightens the face supplies a beneficial-news countercurrent within the human-address noun's root.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the concrete benefit made possible by advance warning.
Shielding a sinner from the effect of sin supplies the reparative good toward which the severe notice can point.

changed_reading.before: Warning and good tidings are affective opposites.
changed_reading.after: The severe warning is paradoxically beneficial news to humans because forewarning leaves time for protection and forgiveness.

strongest_changes: The repeated ب ش ر constructions relocate humanity from the alleged source of speech to the recipient of reminder and warning.
The following advance-or-delay pair turns warning into a directional decision threshold.
The flight scene exposes rejection as escape from the alarm rather than from its danger.
The closing fear, remembrance, protection, and forgiveness sequence gives warning a protective rather than merely punitive purpose.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation made the two-word focus operate simultaneously as commission fulfilled, grammatical reversal, bodily surface-mark, dawn-like forerunner, decision point, reception test, and protective intervention without forcing those mechanisms into one final antecedent.
remaining_uncertainties: The accusative نَذِيرًا can remain attached to more than one plausible antecedent: Saqar, the great event, the preceding signs, the message, or the commissioned warner.
The surface, forerunner, vow, compensation, and tidings activations are branch resonances; the packet does not establish that every one is an intended lexical sense in the focus syntax.
The causal direction from fear-awakening warning to protection and forgiveness is reader-supplied even though each endpoint is packet-grounded.
